resources.string: Results use your saved entries and quotes, without fetching external prices or inventing missing prices.
Value gain or loss can include unrealised valuations. It is not cash received or an annualised rate.
XIRR uses dated external flows and the terminal valuation. The bounded calculation does not guarantee a unique rate.
Time-weighted return requires observed valuations before and after flows; daily closing prices are insufficient.
A return may be unavailable because inputs are missing or no reliable result can be calculated. Values are not invented.
No dated entries or quotes saved yet.
